name: Valentina Herrera
bio:
Valentina's journey into motorsport began unexpectedly. Initially studying architecture in Buenos Aires, she found herself captivated by the intricate designs and material science involved in Formula One car construction after attending the Argentine Grand Prix. She switched her focus, earning a degree in mechanical engineering and specializing in composite materials. Her meticulous attention to detail and passion for pushing the boundaries of performance led her to roles in various racing series before landing at Trident.

At Trident, Valentina is known for her pragmatic approach and dedication to reliability. She believes in a strong foundation of sound engineering principles and rigorous testing. While open to innovation, she prioritizes proven techniques and thorough validation to ensure the structural integrity and performance of the car. Her colleagues value her calm demeanor under pressure and her ability to troubleshoot complex issues efficiently.

What sets Valentina apart is her deep understanding of how materials behave under extreme conditions. She has a knack for identifying potential weaknesses and devising creative solutions to enhance durability and performance. She's always eager to share her knowledge and mentor junior technicians, contributing to a collaborative and learning environment within the team.

physical.hairStyle: Long, straight hair usually tied back in a practical ponytail.
physical.description: Valentina is of average height with a serious, focused expression.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook filled with sketches and calculations.
Has a habit of tapping her pen against her teeth when deep in thought.
Insists on listening to tango music while working on particularly challenging projects.
